en: Dependent on an indeterminate material phenomenon, a non-virtuous non-material phenomenon arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an indeterminate material phenomenon, a non-unwholesome non-material phenomenon arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an indeterminate material phenomenon, both non-virtuous and non-unwholesome non-material phenomena arise by way of root condition.
With respect to root-cause: three … pe … with respect to non-disappearance:
three. Dependent on a wholesome immaterial state: three. Dependent on an unwholesome immaterial state: three. Dependent on an indeterminate immaterial state:
three. With respect to root-cause: nine … pe … with respect to mutuality: three … pe … with respect to resultant: three … pe … with respect to non-disappearance: nine.
